title: Case Digest — Days Since Completion and the Wrong-Item Standing Credit, Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
**Case digest — Cartwise Grocery Orders, the wrong-item standing credit.** A wrong-item refund on a line whose approved replacement was not the product handed over carries a standing credit tied to the time that has passed since the order was completed.

## Rule

The wrong-item standing credit is added after rounding: when **at least 2 calendar days** have passed from the date of the order's completion to today and **no wrong-item refund stands on the order yet**, the credit is **0.40**; when **exactly 1 calendar day** has passed and no wrong-item refund stands on the order yet, the credit is **0.20**; otherwise there is no credit.

Days are calendar days counted from the date part of the completion time: the completion day itself is day 0, the next calendar day is day 1, whatever the hour of handoff.

## Cases (all hypothetical)

| Case | Completed | Today | Wrong-item refund already on the order | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 3 June, 21:40 | 5 June | none | 0.40 |
| B | 3 June, 08:10 | 4 June | none | 0.20 |
| C | 3 June, 11:00 | 3 June | none | none |
| D | 1 June | 5 June | one already stands | none |
| E | 3 June, 23:55 | 4 June, 00:05 | none | 0.20 |

Case E: only ten minutes have passed, but the calendar date has moved by one day, so exactly 1 calendar day has passed.

## Where the credit sits

The credit is added to the refund once the refund has been rounded to the cent; it is not raised or rounded with it. In a hypothetical case where the rounded refund is 4.94 and the credit is 0.40, the refund comes to 5.34.
